sections.title: Form and habitat
sections.text: Onosma echioides is a perennial with a somewhat woody base, reaching about 50 cm. It grows in dry grassland and limestone rockeries of southern Europe, up to about 1,400 m.

sections.title: Leaves, flowers and fruit
sections.text: The lance-shaped leaves and stems are covered in stiff hairs. The pale yellow, pendent tubular flowers are about 2.5 cm long. Each fruit divides into four nutlets 2–3.8 mm long.

sections.title: Identification and edibility
sections.text: The taxon includes subspecies and regional variation; the illustration cannot identify an infraspecific form. No reliable food use or toxicity information was established in the sources consulted.
